content.user_title: Optimize SEO Content and Technical Search Signals
content.value_statement: Search teams need clear SEO guidance that covers content and technical details. This skill gives checklists, templates, and examples for stronger search visibility.
actual_capabilities: Guides keyword research by intent, volume, difficulty, and topic clusters.
Provides examples for title tags, meta descriptions, headers, URLs, and image alt text.
Explains schema markup, robots.txt, XML sitemaps, and canonical tags.
Recommends Core Web Vitals and page speed improvements.
Includes a publishing checklist for on-page and technical SEO review.
Covers featured snippets, local SEO, and monitoring metrics.
limitations: It does not run SEO crawls or collect live ranking data.
Its examples are generic and require site-specific validation.
It cannot guarantee rankings or traffic growth.
Keyword volume and difficulty metrics must come from external tools.

use_cases.title: Optimize a Blog Article
use_cases.description: Align headings, title tags, meta descriptions, image text, and internal links before publishing.

use_cases.title: Audit Technical SEO Basics
use_cases.description: Review structured data, robots.txt rules, sitemap coverage, canonical tags, mobile readiness, and page speed risks.

use_cases.title: Plan Keyword Clusters
use_cases.description: Group keywords into pillar pages and supporting articles based on intent, relevance, and search opportunity.

prompt_templates.title: Review One Page
prompt_templates.prompt: Review this page draft for SEO. Suggest a better title tag, meta description, H1, URL slug, image alt text, and internal links. Keep changes aligned with the target keyword: [keyword].

prompt_templates.title: Build a Keyword Map
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a keyword map for [topic]. Group keywords by intent, identify pillar and cluster pages, and explain which pages should be created first.

prompt_templates.title: Improve Technical SEO
prompt_templates.prompt: Audit these SEO details for [site or page]. Review structured data, robots.txt rules, sitemap coverage, canonical tags, mobile readiness, and Core Web Vitals risks.

prompt_templates.title: Create a Full SEO Plan
prompt_templates.prompt: Build a 90-day SEO plan for [business]. Include keyword research, content clusters, technical fixes, local SEO needs, measurement metrics, and priority order.

output_examples.input: A draft article needs SEO review for the keyword React Hooks guide.
output: Shorten the title so the primary keyword appears near the beginning.
Add a clearer meta description with a benefit and action phrase.
Use one H1 and organize subtopics under descriptive H2 headings.
Add internal links to related React tutorials and performance guides.

output_examples.input: A product page needs a basic technical SEO audit.
output: Confirm the canonical URL points to the preferred product page.
Add product structured data with price, availability, and review details when accurate.
Compress images, set dimensions, and prioritize the largest visible image.
Check that the page is included in the sitemap and not blocked by robots rules.

output_examples.input: A local service business wants better organic visibility.
output: Complete the business profile with accurate categories, hours, services, and photos.
Create service pages for each location and main customer need.
Use local business structured data that matches public business information.
Track calls, form submissions, reviews, and local search impressions.

best_practices: Provide the target keyword, audience, page type, and current draft.
Validate recommendations with analytics, Search Console, and ranking data.
Prioritize user value, page speed, and accessibility alongside keywords.
anti_patterns: Request keyword stuffing, hidden text, or low-quality doorway pages.
Treat placeholder URLs or example markup as production-ready assets.
Expect guaranteed rankings without search data, site context, and ongoing measurement.

faq.question: Does this skill fetch live SEO data?
faq.answer: No. It gives guidance from supplied context and examples. Share metrics from SEO tools for better recommendations.

faq.question: Can it write meta descriptions?
faq.answer: Yes. It can suggest title tags, meta descriptions, headings, URL slugs, and image alt text.

faq.question: Does it support technical SEO work?
faq.answer: Yes. It covers structured data, robots.txt, sitemaps, canonical tags, mobile SEO, and Core Web Vitals.

faq.question: Can it measure Core Web Vitals?
faq.answer: No. It can recommend improvements, but performance measurements must come from tools such as PageSpeed Insights.

faq.question: Can I use it with Claude, Codex, and Claude Code?
faq.answer: Yes. The skill is listed as compatible with Claude, Codex, and Claude Code.

faq.question: Can it guarantee higher rankings?
faq.answer: No. It supports better SEO decisions, but search rankings depend on competition, quality, authority, and technical execution.
